source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֔ן אַתָּ֗ה וּבָנֶ֤יךָ וּבֵית־אָבִ֨יךָ֙ אִתָּ֔ךְ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־עֲוֺ֣ן הַמִּקְדָּ֑שׁ וְאַתָּה֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִתָּ֔ךְ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־עֲוֺ֥ן כְּהֻנַּתְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Aaron, you and your sons and [the] house of your father with you will bear [the] iniquity of the sanctuary, and you and your sons with you will bear [the] iniquity of your priesthood.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Aaron, "You and your sons and your father's house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary, and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Aaron, "You and your sons and your father's family with you will bear the guilt for any offense against the sanctuary, and you and your sons with you will bear the guilt for any offense in your priesthood.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Aaron, "You, your sons and the rest of your father's family will be held responsible if anyone does wrong against the holy place. You and your sons will be held responsible if anyone does wrong in the work of the priests.

es.L: Y dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Aarón: «Tú y tus hijos y la casa de tu padre contigo {{plural_you:cargarán|cargaréis}} con la iniquidad del santuario, y tú y tus hijos contigo {{plural_you:cargarán|cargaréis}} con la iniquidad de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} sacerdocio.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Aarón: «Tú y tus hijos, y la familia de tu padre contigo, {{plural_you:cargarán|cargaréis}} con la culpa de cualquier falta contra el santuario; y tú y tus hijos contigo {{plural_you:cargarán|cargaréis}} con la culpa de cualquier falta en {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} sacerdocio.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Aarón: «Tú, tus hijos y el resto de la familia de tu padre {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} responsables si alguien hace algo malo contra el lugar santo. Tú y tus hijos {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} responsables si alguien hace algo malo en el trabajo de los sacerdotes.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Aaron : « Toi, et tes fils, et la maison de ton père avec toi, vous porterez la faute du sanctuaire ; et toi, et tes fils avec toi, vous porterez la faute de votre sacerdoce.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Aaron : « Toi, tes fils et la famille de ton père avec toi, vous porterez la responsabilité de toute faute commise contre le sanctuaire ; et toi et tes fils avec toi, vous porterez la responsabilité de toute faute commise dans votre sacerdoce.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Aaron : « Toi, tes fils et le reste de la famille de ton père, vous serez tenus pour responsables si quelqu’un commet une faute contre le lieu saint. Toi et tes fils, vous serez tenus pour responsables si quelqu’un commet une faute dans le travail des prêtres.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Haruni, "Wewe na wanao na nyumba ya baba yako pamoja nawe mtaubeba uovu wa mahali patakatifu, nawe na wanao pamoja nawe mtaubeba uovu wa ukuhani wenu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Haruni, "Wewe na wanao na jamaa ya baba yako pamoja nawe mtabeba hatia ya kosa lolote dhidi ya mahali patakatifu, nawe na wanao pamoja nawe mtabeba hatia ya kosa lolote katika ukuhani wenu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Haruni, "Wewe, wanao na jamaa yote ya baba yako mtawajibika ikiwa mtu atafanya kosa dhidi ya mahali patakatifu. Wewe na wanao mtawajibika ikiwa mtu atafanya kosa katika kazi ya makuhani.

decisions.choice: bear the iniquity: carry the guilt, and the penalty, for wrongs done
decisions.reason: The word for iniquity means both a wrong and the guilt or punishment it brings. To bear it is to be answerable for it (Leviticus 5:1; 10:17). Here the priests and Levites are made answerable for any wrong against the holy place, including an outsider coming too near, so that the danger falls on them and not on the whole people.

decisions.choice: your father's house: the wider family of Levi
decisions.reason: The father's house is the larger family Aaron belongs to. Verse 2 names it as the tribe of Levi, so it means Aaron's fellow Levites, who share the duty of guarding the holy place. Some take it more narrowly as the clan of Kohath, who carried the holy things (4:4-15).

decisions.choice: the LORD's answer to the people's fear
decisions.reason: The chapter follows the people's cry that everyone who comes near the tabernacle dies (17:27-28). The LORD answers by setting guards around the holy place: priests and Levites who carry the responsibility so that the people can live. He speaks to Aaron directly here and again in verses 8 and 20, which is rare (Leviticus 10:8).

decisions.choice: the iniquity of your priesthood: wrongs in the priests' own work
decisions.reason: The first half covers the whole sanctuary and the whole family of Levi; the second narrows to Aaron and his sons and what only priests may do, the altar and what is inside the curtain (verse 7).

decisions.choice: bear the guilt for any offense (Balanced); be held responsible if anyone does wrong (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what bearing iniquity means here. Literal keeps "bear the iniquity", the phrase that returns in verses 22, 23 and 32.

decisions.choice: passé simple at L and B ("dit"); passé composé at R ("a dit")
decisions.reason: As the French style guide sets for narrative: the passé simple of written narrative at Literal and Balanced, the spoken passé composé at Readable. The laws inside the speeches use the future.

source.text: וְגַ֣ם אֶת־אַחֶיךָ֩ מַטֵּ֨ה לֵוִ֜י שֵׁ֤בֶט אָבִ֨יךָ֙ הַקְרֵ֣ב אִתָּ֔ךְ וְיִלָּו֥וּ עָלֶ֖יךָ וִֽישָׁרְת֑וּךָ וְאַתָּה֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִתָּ֔ךְ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל הָעֵדֻֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And also your brothers, [the] tribe of Levi, [the] tribe of your father, bring near with you, and they will be joined to you and will serve you, and you and your sons with you [will be] before [the] tent of the testimony.

en.L: And also your brothers, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, bring near with you, that they may be joined to you and minister to you, while you and your sons with you [are] before the tent of the testimony.
en.B: Bring with you also your relatives, the tribe of Levi, your ancestral tribe, so that they may join you and assist you while you and your sons with you are in front of the tent of the testimony.
en.R: Bring your relatives from the tribe of Levi, your own family tribe, to work with you. They will join you and help you, while you and your sons serve in front of the tent that holds the covenant tablets.

es.L: Y también a tus hermanos, la tribu de Leví, la tribu de tu padre, haz que se acerquen contigo, para que se unan a ti y te sirvan, mientras tú y tus hijos contigo {{plural_you:[están]|[estáis]}} delante de la Tienda del Testimonio.
es.B: Trae también contigo a tus hermanos, la tribu de Leví, la tribu de tus antepasados, para que se unan a ti y te ayuden mientras tú y tus hijos {{plural_you:están|estáis}} delante de la Tienda del Testimonio.
es.R: Trae a tus parientes de la tribu de Leví, la tribu de tu familia, para que trabajen contigo. Ellos se unirán a ti y te ayudarán, mientras tú y tus hijos {{plural_you:sirven|servís}} delante de la tienda que guarda las tablas del pacto.

fr.L: Et aussi tes frères, la tribu de Lévi, la tribu de ton père, fais-les approcher avec toi, pour qu’ils te soient joints et qu’ils te servent, tandis que toi et tes fils avec toi [serez] devant la tente du Témoignage.
fr.B: Fais aussi venir avec toi tes frères, la tribu de Lévi, la tribu de tes ancêtres, pour qu’ils se joignent à toi et t’assistent, pendant que toi et tes fils avec toi, vous serez devant la tente du Témoignage.
fr.R: Fais venir tes frères de la tribu de Lévi, la tribu de ta famille, pour qu’ils travaillent avec toi. Ils se joindront à toi et t’aideront, pendant que toi et tes fils, vous servirez devant la tente qui contient les tablettes de l’alliance.

sw.L: Na pia ndugu zako, kabila la Lawi, kabila la baba yako, uwalete karibu pamoja nawe, ili waungane nawe na kukuhudumia, huku wewe na wanao pamoja nawe [mkiwa] mbele ya Hema la Ushuhuda.
sw.B: Walete pia pamoja nawe ndugu zako, kabila la Lawi, kabila la mababu zako, ili waungane nawe na kukusaidia, huku wewe na wanao pamoja nawe mkiwa mbele ya Hema la Ushuhuda.
sw.R: Walete ndugu zako wa kabila la Lawi, kabila la jamaa yako, ili wafanye kazi pamoja nawe. Wataungana nawe na kukusaidia, huku wewe na wanao mkihudumu mbele ya hema lenye vibao vya agano.

decisions.choice: be joined: a play on the name Levi
decisions.reason: The verb sounds like the name Levi. When Levi was born, Leah said, "Now my husband will be joined to me" (Genesis 29:34). Here the tribe of Levi is joined to Aaron, and the word is repeated in verse 4.

decisions.choice: minister to you: serve as assistants, not as priests
decisions.reason: The verb is used of attendants who serve someone of higher rank, as Joshua served Moses (Exodus 24:13). The Levites serve the priests and the congregation (3:6; 16:9), but the work at the altar stays with the priests (verse 3).

decisions.choice: the tent of the testimony: the tent that holds the covenant tablets
decisions.reason: The testimony is the two stone tablets of the covenant, kept in the ark (Exodus 25:16; 31:18). The tent is named after what it holds.

decisions.choice: you and your sons before the tent: the priests' place, while the Levites assist
alternatives: and you and your sons shall be before the tent
decisions.reason: The last clause has no verb. It sets the priests in front of the tent, at the altar and the sanctuary, while the Levites serve alongside them. It can also be read as a further command, "you and your sons shall be before the tent"; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: the tent that holds the covenant tablets
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the testimony" in the same way it explains "the ark of the testimony" (4:5).

decisions.choice: serve in front of
decisions.reason: Readable adds the verb "serve" to the clause the Hebrew leaves without one; the priests are in front of the tent to do their work there.

source.text: וְשָֽׁמְרוּ֙ מִֽשְׁמַרְתְּךָ֔ וּמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת כָּל־הָאֹ֑הֶל אַךְ֩ אֶל־כְּלֵ֨י הַקֹּ֤דֶשׁ וְאֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לֹ֣א יִקְרָ֔בוּ וְלֹֽא־יָמֻ֥תוּ גַם־הֵ֖ם גַּם־אַתֶּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will keep your charge and [the] charge of all the tent; only to [the] vessels of the holy place and to the altar not they will draw near, and not they will die, also they, also you.

en.L: And they shall keep your charge and the charge of the whole tent; only they shall not come near the vessels of the sanctuary or the altar, so that they do not die, both they and you.
en.B: They are to carry out their duties to you and their duties for the whole tent, but they must not come near the holy furnishings or the altar, or both they and you will die.
en.R: They must do the work you give them and take care of the whole tent. But they must not go near the holy objects or the altar. If they do, both they and you will die.

es.L: Y guardarán tu encargo y el encargo de toda la tienda; solo que no se acercarán a los utensilios del santuario ni al altar, para que no mueran, ni ellos ni {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Ellos cumplirán sus deberes para contigo y para con toda la tienda, pero no deben acercarse a los objetos sagrados ni al altar, o morirán tanto ellos como {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Ellos deben hacer el trabajo que les des y cuidar toda la tienda. Pero no deben acercarse a los objetos sagrados ni al altar. Si lo hacen, morirán ellos y también {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Et ils garderont ta charge et la charge de toute la tente ; seulement, ils ne s’approcheront pas des objets du sanctuaire ni de l’autel, afin qu’ils ne meurent pas, ni eux ni vous.
fr.B: Ils assureront leur service auprès de toi et le service de toute la tente, mais ils ne doivent pas s’approcher des objets sacrés ni de l’autel, sinon ils mourront, eux aussi bien que vous.
fr.R: Ils doivent faire le travail que tu leur donnes et s’occuper de toute la tente. Mais ils ne doivent pas s’approcher des objets sacrés ni de l’autel. S’ils le font, eux et vous, vous mourrez tous.

sw.L: Nao watashika ulinzi wako na ulinzi wa hema lote; ila wasikaribie vyombo vya mahali patakatifu wala madhabahu, ili wasife, wao wala ninyi.
sw.B: Watatimiza wajibu wao kwako na wajibu wa hema lote, lakini wasikaribie vyombo vitakatifu wala madhabahu, la sivyo watakufa, wao na ninyi pia.
sw.R: Lazima wafanye kazi utakayowapa na kulitunza hema lote. Lakini wasikaribie vifaa vitakatifu wala madhabahu. Wakifanya hivyo, wao na ninyi pia mtakufa.

decisions.choice: keep your charge: carry out the duties given them, including guard duty
decisions.reason: The word means something kept or guarded, and so a duty. The Levites carry out duties for the priests and for the whole tent (3:7-8), and part of the duty is to guard it, so that no one comes near who should not.

decisions.choice: the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar: the things only priests may handle
decisions.reason: The holy furnishings inside the tent and the altar of sacrifice were for the priests alone. Even the Levites who carried them were not to see or touch them uncovered, or they would die (4:15, 20).

decisions.choice: both they and you: the priests die too
decisions.reason: If a Levite goes where only priests may go, the guilt falls not only on him but also on the priests, who are answerable for the holy place (verse 1).

decisions.choice: or both they and you will die
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "and they will not die", that is, so that they do not die. Balanced and Readable say it as a warning of what happens otherwise. Literal keeps the purpose clause.

source.text: וְנִלְו֣וּ עָלֶ֔יךָ וְשָֽׁמְר֗וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֨רֶת֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד לְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאֹ֑הֶל וְזָ֖ר לֹא־יִקְרַ֥ב אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will be joined to you and keep [the] charge of [the] tent of meeting for all [the] service of the tent, and [an] outsider not will draw near to you.

en.L: And they shall be joined to you and keep the charge of the tent of meeting, for all the service of the tent; and an outsider shall not come near you.
en.B: They are to join you and carry out the duties of the tent of meeting, all the work of the tent, and no outsider may come near you.
en.R: They will join you and take care of the meeting tent and do all the work there. No one else may come near you.

es.L: Y se unirán a ti y guardarán el encargo de la Tienda del Encuentro, para todo el servicio de la tienda; y el extraño no se acercará a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Ellos se unirán a ti y cumplirán los deberes de la Tienda del Encuentro, todo el trabajo de la tienda, y ningún extraño se acercará a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Ellos se unirán a ti, cuidarán la Tienda del Encuentro y harán allí todo el trabajo. Ninguna otra persona puede acercarse a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Et ils te seront joints et garderont la charge de la tente de la Rencontre, pour tout le service de la tente ; et le profane ne s’approchera pas de vous.
fr.B: Ils se joindront à toi et assureront le service de la tente de la Rencontre, tout le travail de la tente, et aucun profane ne s’approchera de vous.
fr.R: Ils se joindront à toi, ils s’occuperont de la tente de la Rencontre et ils y feront tout le travail. Aucune autre personne n’a le droit de s’approcher de vous.

sw.L: Nao wataungana nawe, na kushika ulinzi wa Hema la Kukutania, kwa huduma yote ya hema; na mtu wa nje asiwakaribie ninyi.
sw.B: Wataungana nawe na kutimiza wajibu wa Hema la Kukutania, kazi yote ya hema, wala mtu wa nje asiwakaribie ninyi.
sw.R: Wataungana nawe, watalitunza Hema la Kukutania na kufanya kazi yote huko. Mtu mwingine yeyote asiwakaribie ninyi.

decisions.choice: an outsider: anyone not of the tribe of Levi
decisions.reason: The word means someone who does not belong. Its meaning depends on whom it is set against: here, against the Levites, it means any Israelite of another tribe (1:51). In verse 7, set against the priests, it means anyone who is not a priest.

decisions.choice: come near you: come near the priests at the holy place
decisions.reason: "You" is plural: Aaron and his sons at their work. No one but the Levites may approach the area where the priests serve.

decisions.choice: No one else
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly who the outsider is, as in 1:51.

source.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֵ֖ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה ע֛וֹד קֶ֖צֶף עַל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will keep [the] charge of the holy place and [the] charge of the altar, and not will be again wrath on [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And you shall keep the charge of the sanctuary and the charge of the altar, so that there may be no more wrath on the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: You are to carry out the duties of the sanctuary and the duties of the altar, so that wrath will not fall again on the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: You priests must take care of the holy place and the altar. Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not be angry with the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} again.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:guardarán|guardaréis}} el encargo del santuario y el encargo del altar, para que no haya más ira sobre los hijos de Israel.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes cumplirán|Vosotros cumpliréis}} los deberes del santuario y los deberes del altar, para que la ira no vuelva a caer sobre los israelitas.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}}, los sacerdotes, {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} cuidar el lugar santo y el altar. Así {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no volverá a enojarse con los israelitas.

fr.L: Et vous garderez la charge du sanctuaire et la charge de l’autel, afin qu’il n’y ait plus de colère sur les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: Vous assurerez le service du sanctuaire et le service de l’autel, pour que la colère ne tombe plus sur les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.
fr.R: Vous, les prêtres, vous devez vous occuper du lieu saint et de l’autel. Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne sera plus en colère contre les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.

sw.L: Nanyi mtashika ulinzi wa mahali patakatifu na ulinzi wa madhabahu, ili isiwepo tena ghadhabu juu ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Mtatimiza wajibu wa mahali patakatifu na wajibu wa madhabahu, ili ghadhabu isiwaangukie tena Waisraeli.
sw.R: Ninyi makuhani lazima mtunze mahali patakatifu na madhabahu. Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatawakasirikia tena Waisraeli.

decisions.choice: wrath: the LORD's anger, which had just struck the people
decisions.reason: The word was last used when wrath went out from the LORD and the plague began (17:11). The Levites camp around the tabernacle so that there will be no wrath on the congregation (1:53). Careful guarding of the holy place is meant to keep it from happening again.

decisions.choice: you: plural, Aaron and his sons
decisions.reason: The verb is plural. After the Levites' duties in verses 3-4, these are the priests' own duties.

decisions.choice: You priests; the LORD will not be angry
decisions.reason: Readable names who "you" are and says whose wrath it is. The Hebrew does not name the LORD here, but the wrath is his (17:11).

source.text: וַאֲנִ֗י הִנֵּ֤ה לָקַ֨חְתִּי֙ אֶת־אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לָכֶ֞ם מַתָּנָ֤ה נְתֻנִים֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לַעֲבֹ֕ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And I, look, I have taken your brothers the Levites from among [the] sons of Israel; to you [they are a] gift, given to Yahweh, to serve [the] service of [the] tent of meeting.

en.L: And I, look, I have taken your brothers the Levites from among the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel; to you [they are] a gift, given to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to do the service of the tent of meeting.
en.B: I myself have taken your relatives the Levites from among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. They are a gift to you, given to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to do the work of the tent of meeting.
en.R: I have chosen your relatives the Levites from among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. They are a gift to you. They have been given to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to do the work at the meeting tent.

es.L: Y yo, he aquí, he tomado a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos los levitas de entre los hijos de Israel; para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} [son] un regalo, dados {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, para hacer el servicio de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.B: Yo mismo he tomado a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos los levitas de entre los israelitas. Son un regalo para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, dados {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, para hacer el trabajo de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.R: He escogido a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} parientes los levitas de entre los israelitas. Son un regalo para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Han sido entregados {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} para hacer el trabajo en la Tienda del Encuentro.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, voici, j’ai pris vos frères, les Lévites, du milieu des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël ; pour vous, [ils sont] un don, donnés {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, pour faire le service de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.B: C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui ai pris vos frères les Lévites du milieu des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Ils sont un don pour vous, donnés {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, pour faire le travail de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.R: J’ai choisi vos frères les Lévites parmi les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Ils sont un cadeau pour vous. Ils ont été donnés {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} pour faire le travail à la tente de la Rencontre.

sw.L: Nami, tazama, nimewatwaa ndugu zenu Walawi kutoka miongoni mwa wana wa Israeli; kwenu [wao ni] zawadi, waliotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili kufanya huduma ya Hema la Kukutania.
sw.B: Mimi mwenyewe nimewachukua ndugu zenu Walawi kutoka miongoni mwa Waisraeli. Wao ni zawadi kwenu, waliotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili kufanya kazi ya Hema la Kukutania.
sw.R: Nimewachagua ndugu zenu Walawi kutoka miongoni mwa Waisraeli. Wao ni zawadi kwenu. Wametolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ili wafanye kazi katika Hema la Kukutania.

decisions.choice: I have taken the Levites: as already told in chapters 3 and 8
decisions.reason: The LORD took the Levites in place of Israel's firstborn and gave them to Aaron and his sons (3:9, 12; 8:16-19). The point is repeated here to show that their service is the LORD's gift, not something Aaron or the Levites claimed for themselves.

decisions.choice: a gift to you, given to the LORD: they belong to the LORD first
decisions.reason: The Levites are given to the LORD, and so they are his to give to the priests. The word "given" echoes "given, given" in 3:9 and 8:16.

decisions.choice: And I, look: the LORD stresses that he is the one acting
decisions.reason: The pronoun "I" is written out before the verb, and "look" points to what follows. The same opening returns in verse 8.

decisions.choice: I myself
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the stressed "I" as "I myself". Literal keeps "And I, look".

source.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִ֠תְּךָ תִּשְׁמְר֨וּ אֶת־כְּהֻנַּתְכֶ֜ם לְכָל־דְּבַ֧ר הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ וּלְמִבֵּ֥ית לַפָּרֹ֖כֶת וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֑ם עֲבֹדַ֣ת מַתָּנָ֗ה אֶתֵּן֙ אֶת־כְּהֻנַּתְכֶ֔ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And you and your sons with you will keep your priesthood for every matter of the altar and for from inside the curtain, and you will serve; [a] service of gift I give your priesthood, and the outsider who draws near will be put to death.

en.L: And you and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood in every matter of the altar and of what is inside the veil, and you shall serve; I give your priesthood [as] a service of gift; and the outsider who comes near shall be put to death."
en.B: But you and your sons with you are to carry out your priesthood in everything to do with the altar and with what is behind the curtain, and you are to do that service. I am giving you your priesthood as a gift for service. Any outsider who comes near is to be put to death."
en.R: But only you and your sons may do the work of priests at the altar and behind the curtain. I am giving you the work of priests as a gift. Anyone else who comes near must be put to death."

es.L: Y tú y tus hijos contigo {{plural_you:guardarán|guardaréis}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} sacerdocio en todo asunto del altar y de lo que está dentro del velo, y {{plural_you:servirán|serviréis}}; doy {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} sacerdocio [como] un servicio de regalo; y el extraño que se acerque será condenado a muerte».
es.B: Pero tú y tus hijos contigo {{plural_you:ejercerán|ejerceréis}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} sacerdocio en todo lo que tiene que ver con el altar y con lo que está detrás de la cortina, y {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} ese servicio. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} doy {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} sacerdocio como un regalo para servir. Cualquier extraño que se acerque será condenado a muerte».
es.R: Pero solo tú y tus hijos {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} hacer el trabajo de sacerdotes en el altar y detrás de la cortina. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} doy el trabajo de sacerdotes como un regalo. Cualquier otra persona que se acerque debe morir».

fr.L: Et toi et tes fils avec toi, vous garderez votre sacerdoce en toute affaire de l’autel et de ce qui est à l’intérieur du voile, et vous servirez ; je donne votre sacerdoce [comme] un service de don ; et le profane qui s’approchera sera mis à mort. »
fr.B: Mais toi et tes fils avec toi, vous exercerez votre sacerdoce pour tout ce qui concerne l’autel et ce qui est derrière le rideau, et vous accomplirez ce service. Je vous donne votre sacerdoce comme un don, pour le service. Tout profane qui s’approchera sera mis à mort. »
fr.R: Mais seuls toi et tes fils, vous pouvez faire le travail de prêtres à l’autel et derrière le rideau. Je vous donne le travail de prêtres comme un cadeau. Toute autre personne qui s’approchera devra être mise à mort. »

sw.L: Nawe na wanao pamoja nawe mtalinda ukuhani wenu kwa kila jambo la madhabahu na la kilicho ndani ya pazia, nanyi mtatumika; ninautoa ukuhani wenu [kuwa] huduma ya zawadi; na mtu wa nje atakayekaribia atauawa."
sw.B: Lakini wewe na wanao pamoja nawe mtatimiza ukuhani wenu katika kila kitu kinachohusu madhabahu na kilicho nyuma ya pazia, nanyi mtafanya huduma hiyo. Ninawapa ukuhani wenu kuwa zawadi ya huduma. Mtu wa nje yeyote atakayekaribia atauawa."
sw.R: Lakini ni wewe na wanao tu mnaoweza kufanya kazi ya makuhani madhabahuni na nyuma ya pazia. Ninawapa kazi ya ukuhani kama zawadi. Mtu mwingine yeyote atakayekaribia lazima auawe."

decisions.choice: inside the veil: the Most Holy Place
decisions.reason: The veil was the curtain that closed off the inner room where the ark stood. Only the high priest went in, once a year, on the Day of Atonement (Leviticus 16:2, 12-15).

decisions.choice: a service of gift: the priesthood is the LORD's gift, not a right
alternatives: I give you your priesthood as a service that is a gift
decisions.reason: After Korah and his company had claimed the priesthood for themselves (16:3, 10), the LORD says the priesthood is his gift to Aaron's family. The phrase is unusual; it may mean "I give your priesthood as a gift" or "I give you a service that is a gift". Either way the priesthood comes from the LORD.

decisions.choice: the outsider: anyone who is not a priest, Levites included
decisions.reason: Here the outsider is set against Aaron and his sons, so it means anyone not descended from Aaron (3:10; 17:5).

decisions.choice: only you and your sons
decisions.reason: Readable adds "only" to bring out the contrast with the Levites in verses 3-4, which the Hebrew makes by starting with "you".

decisions.choice: veil (Literal); curtain (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Leviticus 16:2: Literal keeps "veil" for this curtain; Balanced and Readable say "curtain".

source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹן֒ וַאֲנִי֙ הִנֵּ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּֽי לְךָ֔ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת תְּרוּמֹתָ֑י לְכָל־קָדְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל לְךָ֨נְתַתִּ֧ים לְמָשְׁחָ֛ה וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ לְחָק־עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And spoke Yahweh to Aaron, and I, look, I have given to you [the] charge of my contributions for all [the] holy things of [the] sons of Israel; to you I have given them for [a] portion and to your sons for [a] due forever.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Aaron, "And I, look, I have given you the charge of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} contributions, of all the holy things of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel; to you I have given them as a portion, and to your sons, as a due forever.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Aaron: "I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} have put you in charge of the contributions made to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, all the holy gifts of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. I have given them to you and your sons as your portion, a permanent share.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Aaron, "I have put you in charge of the special gifts that people give to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I am giving all the holy gifts of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} to you and your sons. They will be your share for all time.

es.L: Y habló {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Aarón: «Y yo, he aquí, te he dado el cargo de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ofrendas alzadas, de todas las cosas santas de los hijos de Israel; a ti te las he dado como porción, y a tus hijos, como derecho perpetuo.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Aarón: «Yo mismo te he puesto a cargo de las contribuciones que se {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} hacen, todas las ofrendas santas de los israelitas. Te las he dado a ti y a tus hijos como su porción, una parte permanente.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Aarón: «Te he puesto a cargo de las ofrendas especiales que la gente {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} da. Te doy todas las ofrendas santas de los israelitas a ti y a tus hijos. Serán su parte para siempre.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parla à Aaron : « Et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, voici, je t’ai donné la charge de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} offrandes élevées, de toutes les choses saintes des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël ; je te les ai données comme part, et à tes fils, comme dû perpétuel.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Aaron : « C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui t’ai confié les contributions qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sont faites, tous les dons saints des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Je te les ai donnés, à toi et à tes fils, comme votre part, une part permanente.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Aaron : « Je t’ai confié les dons spéciaux que les gens {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} font. Je te donne tous les dons saints des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, à toi et à tes fils. Ce sera votre part pour toujours.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akanena na Haruni, "Nami, tazama, nimekupa ulinzi wa sadaka {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} za kuinuliwa, za vitu vyote vitakatifu vya wana wa Israeli; nimekupa wewe kuwa fungu lako, na wanao, kuwa fungu la kudumu milele.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Haruni, "Mimi mwenyewe nimekuweka usimamie michango inayotolewa {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}, matoleo yote matakatifu ya Waisraeli. Nimekupa wewe na wanao kuwa fungu lenu, fungu la kudumu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Haruni, "Nimekuweka usimamie zawadi maalum ambazo watu huniletea {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}. Ninakupa wewe na wanao matoleo yote matakatifu ya Waisraeli. Yatakuwa fungu lenu milele.

decisions.choice: the charge of my contributions: the care of them and the right to them
decisions.reason: The word used for the Levites' duties in verses 3-5 here means what is kept in someone's care. The priests are put in charge of the gifts set apart for the LORD, and they receive them as their own.

decisions.choice: contribution: a portion set apart from a larger whole for holy use
decisions.reason: As in 5:9: the word comes from a verb meaning to lift up or set aside.

decisions.choice: as a portion
decisions.reason: The word may come from a root meaning to measure out, giving "as a portion", or from the verb "anoint", giving "because of the anointing", that is, because the priests were anointed to their office (Leviticus 7:35). The parallel phrase "as a due forever" favors "portion", but the other reading is possible.

decisions.choice: a due forever: a fixed share that lasts
decisions.reason: The phrase is used for the priests' lasting share of the offerings (Leviticus 7:34; 10:15). It returns in verses 11 and 19.

decisions.choice: special gifts
decisions.reason: As in 5:9: Readable says "special gift" for the contribution.

decisions.choice: "fungu la kudumu milele" (L), "fungu la kudumu" (B) for "a due forever"
decisions.reason: The phrase means a fixed share that lasts. "Haki" would say "right", but the style guide keeps "haki" for righteousness, so the share is called a "fungu". The same wording returns in verses 11 and 19.

source.text: זֶֽה־יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ מִקֹּ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים מִן־הָאֵ֑שׁ כָּל־קָ֠רְבָּנָם לְֽכָל־מִנְחָתָ֞ם וּלְכָל־חַטָּאתָ֗ם וּלְכָל־אֲשָׁמָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָשִׁ֣יבוּ לִ֔י קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים לְךָ֛ ה֖וּא וּלְבָנֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: This will be to you from [the] holy of the holy things, from the fire: every offering of theirs, for every grain offering of theirs and for every sin offering of theirs and for every guilt offering of theirs which they return to me, [a] holy of holy things for you it [is] and for your sons.

en.L: This shall be yours from the most holy things, [kept] from the fire: every offering of theirs, every grain offering of theirs and every sin offering of theirs and every guilt offering of theirs, which they render to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; it [is] most holy for you and for your sons.
en.B: This is what will be yours from the most holy things, the part not burned in the fire: every offering they bring, whether grain offering, sin offering or guilt offering that they pay back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. It is most holy, for you and your sons.
en.R: Some of the most holy offerings will belong to you, the parts that are not burned on the altar. From every grain offering, sin offering and guilt offering they bring {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, you will get a share. It is very holy and is for you and your sons.

es.L: Esto será tuyo de las cosas santísimas, [apartado] del fuego: toda ofrenda de ellos, toda ofrenda de cereal de ellos y todo sacrificio por el pecado de ellos y todo sacrificio por la culpa de ellos que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} devuelvan; [es] santísimo para ti y para tus hijos.
es.B: Esto es lo que será tuyo de las cosas santísimas, la parte que no se quema en el fuego: toda ofrenda que traigan, ya sea ofrenda de cereal, sacrificio por el pecado o sacrificio por la culpa que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} paguen. Es santísimo, para ti y para tus hijos.
es.R: Una parte de las ofrendas muy santas será tuya: lo que no se quema en el altar. De cada ofrenda de cereal, sacrificio por el pecado y sacrificio por la culpa que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} traigan, tú recibirás una parte. Es muy santo y es para ti y para tus hijos.

fr.L: Ceci sera à toi parmi les choses très saintes, [soustraites] au feu : toutes leurs offrandes, toutes leurs offrandes végétales, tous leurs sacrifices pour le péché et tous leurs sacrifices de réparation qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} rendent ; c’est une chose très sainte pour toi et pour tes fils.
fr.B: Voici ce qui sera à toi parmi les choses très saintes, la part qui n’est pas brûlée au feu : toutes les offrandes qu’ils apportent, qu’il s’agisse d’offrandes végétales, de sacrifices pour le péché ou de sacrifices de réparation qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} rendent. C’est très saint, pour toi et pour tes fils.
fr.R: Une partie des offrandes très saintes sera à toi : les parts qui ne sont pas brûlées sur l’autel. Sur chaque offrande végétale, chaque sacrifice pour le péché et chaque sacrifice de réparation qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}apportent, tu recevras une part. C’est très saint, et c’est pour toi et tes fils.

sw.L: Hiki kitakuwa chako katika vitu vitakatifu kabisa, [vilivyozuiliwa] na moto: kila sadaka yao, kila sadaka yao ya nafaka, na kila sadaka yao ya dhambi, na kila sadaka yao ya hatia, wanayonirudishia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}; ni takatifu kabisa kwako na kwa wanao.
sw.B: Hiki ndicho kitakachokuwa chako katika vitu vitakatifu kabisa, sehemu isiyochomwa motoni: kila sadaka wanayoleta, iwe sadaka ya nafaka, sadaka ya dhambi au sadaka ya hatia wanayonilipa {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}. Ni takatifu kabisa, kwa ajili yako na wanao.
sw.R: Sehemu ya sadaka takatifu sana itakuwa yako, yaani sehemu zisizochomwa madhabahuni. Katika kila sadaka ya nafaka, sadaka ya dhambi na sadaka ya hatia wanayoniletea {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, utapata sehemu. Ni takatifu sana, nayo ni yako na ya wanao.

decisions.choice: the most holy things: offerings of the highest holiness
decisions.reason: "Holy of holy things" is the Hebrew way of saying "most holy". The grain offering, sin offering and guilt offering are called most holy (Leviticus 6:10, 18; 7:1, 6), and only the priests may eat their share of them.

decisions.choice: from the fire: the part kept back from the altar fire
decisions.reason: Part of each of these offerings was burned on the altar; the rest went to the priests (Leviticus 2:2-3; 6:19; 7:6-7).

decisions.choice: which they render to me: what they pay back
alternatives: which they give back to me (all the offerings)
decisions.reason: The verb means to give back or make good. It fits the guilt offering best, which went with paying back what was wrongly taken (5:7-8; Leviticus 5:23-25), but it may refer to all the offerings listed, as what the people owe the LORD.

decisions.choice: they bring me
decisions.reason: Readable says the offerings are brought to the LORD and leaves the idea of paying back to Balanced and Literal.

source.text: בְּקֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים תֹּאכֲלֶ֑נּוּ כָּל־זָכָר֙ יֹאכַ֣ל אֹת֔וֹ קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִֽהְיֶה־לָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: In [the] holy of the holy things you will eat it; every male will eat it; holy it will be to you.

en.L: In a most holy [place] you shall eat it; every male shall eat it; it shall be holy to you.
en.B: You are to eat it in a most holy place. Every male may eat it. It is to be holy to you.
en.R: You must eat it in a place set apart as very holy. Any male in the priests' families may eat it. You must treat it as holy.

es.L: En un [lugar] santísimo lo comerás; todo varón lo comerá; santo será para ti.
es.B: Lo comerás en un lugar santísimo. Todo varón podrá comerlo. Será santo para ti.
es.R: Debes comerlo en un lugar apartado como muy santo. Cualquier varón de las familias de los sacerdotes puede comerlo. Debes tratarlo como algo santo.

fr.L: Dans un [lieu] très saint tu le mangeras ; tout mâle en mangera ; ce sera pour toi une chose sainte.
fr.B: Tu le mangeras dans un lieu très saint. Tout mâle pourra en manger. Ce sera saint pour toi.
fr.R: Tu dois le manger dans un endroit mis à part comme très saint. Tout homme des familles de prêtres peut en manger. Tu dois le traiter comme une chose sainte.

sw.L: Katika [mahali] patakatifu kabisa utakila; kila mwanamume atakila; kitakuwa kitakatifu kwako.
sw.B: Utakila mahali patakatifu kabisa. Kila mwanamume anaweza kukila. Kitakuwa kitakatifu kwako.
sw.R: Lazima ukile mahali palipotengwa kuwa patakatifu sana. Mwanamume yeyote wa jamaa za makuhani anaweza kukila. Lazima ukichukulie kuwa kitu kitakatifu.

decisions.choice: in a most holy place
alternatives: as most holy things you shall eat it
decisions.reason: The words are the same as "the most holy things" in verse 9, with "in" before them. Leviticus says these offerings are eaten "in a holy place, in the court of the tent of meeting" (Leviticus 6:9, 19), so this is taken as the place. It could also mean "as most holy things you shall eat it", describing the food rather than the place.

decisions.choice: every male: the male members of the priests' families
decisions.reason: The most holy portions were only for men of Aaron's line (Leviticus 6:11; 7:6). The gifts in verses 11-19 are less holy, and the priests' daughters and clean members of the household may share them.

decisions.choice: Any male in the priests' families
decisions.reason: Readable says which males are meant, as in Leviticus 7:6.

source.text: וְזֶה־לְּךָ֞ תְּרוּמַ֣ת מַתָּנָ֗ם לְכָל־תְּנוּפֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לְךָ֣ נְתַתִּ֗ים וּלְבָנֶ֧יךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶ֛יךָ אִתְּךָ֖ לְחָק־עוֹלָ֑ם כָּל־טָה֥וֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ יֹאכַ֥ל אֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And this [is] to you: [the] contribution of their gift, for all [the] wave offerings of [the] sons of Israel; to you I have given them and to your sons and to your daughters with you for [a] due forever; every clean [one] in your house will eat it.

en.L: And this [is] yours: the contribution of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel; I have given them to you and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a due forever; everyone who is clean in your house may eat it.
en.B: This also is yours: the contribution from their gifts, together with all the wave offerings of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. I have given them to you and to your sons and daughters with you as a permanent share. Everyone in your household who is clean may eat it.
en.R: These gifts also belong to you: the special gifts and all the offerings that the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} wave before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I am giving them to you and your sons and daughters for all time. Anyone in your family who is clean may eat them.

es.L: Y esto [es] tuyo: la ofrenda alzada de su don, con todas las ofrendas mecidas de los hijos de Israel; te las he dado a ti y a tus hijos y a tus hijas contigo, como derecho perpetuo; todo el que esté puro en tu casa podrá comerlo.
es.B: Esto también es tuyo: la contribución de sus dones, junto con todas las ofrendas mecidas de los israelitas. Te las he dado a ti y a tus hijos y a tus hijas contigo como una parte permanente. Todo el que esté puro en tu casa podrá comerlas.
es.R: Estas ofrendas también son tuyas: las ofrendas especiales y todas las ofrendas que los israelitas mecen delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Te las doy a ti y a tus hijos y a tus hijas para siempre. Cualquier persona de tu familia que esté pura puede comerlas.

fr.L: Et ceci [est] à toi : l’offrande élevée de leur don, avec toutes les offrandes balancées des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël ; je te les ai données, à toi, à tes fils et à tes filles avec toi, comme dû perpétuel ; quiconque est pur dans ta maison en mangera.
fr.B: Ceci aussi est à toi : la contribution prélevée sur leurs dons, avec toutes les offrandes balancées des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Je te les ai données, à toi, à tes fils et à tes filles avec toi, comme une part permanente. Tous ceux de ta maison qui sont purs pourront en manger.
fr.R: Ces dons aussi sont à toi : les dons spéciaux et toutes les offrandes que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} balancent devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Je te les donne, à toi, à tes fils et à tes filles, pour toujours. Toute personne de ta famille qui est pure peut en manger.

sw.L: Na hiki [ni] chako: sadaka ya kuinuliwa ya zawadi yao, pamoja na sadaka zote za kutikiswa za wana wa Israeli; nimekupa wewe na wanao na binti zako pamoja nawe, kuwa fungu la kudumu milele; kila aliye safi nyumbani mwako atakila.
sw.B: Hiki pia ni chako: mchango kutoka kwa zawadi zao, pamoja na sadaka zote za kutikiswa za Waisraeli. Nimekupa wewe na wanao na binti zako pamoja nawe kuwa fungu la kudumu. Kila aliye safi nyumbani mwako anaweza kukila.
sw.R: Zawadi hizi pia ni zako: zawadi maalum na sadaka zote ambazo Waisraeli huzitikisa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Ninakupa wewe na wanao na binti zako milele. Mtu yeyote wa jamaa yako aliye safi anaweza kuzila.

decisions.choice: the contribution of their gift: the part set apart from their gifts
decisions.reason: The portion set aside for the priest from the gifts the people bring, as in 5:9 and verse 8.

decisions.choice: wave offerings: portions lifted up before the LORD and then given to the priests
decisions.reason: Part of an offering, such as the breast of a peace offering, was raised and moved before the LORD to show that it was his, and then it went to the priests (Leviticus 7:30-34; 10:14-15).

decisions.choice: everyone who is clean: anyone free of ritual uncleanness
decisions.reason: Only those not made unclean, by contact with a dead body or a discharge for example, could eat holy food (Leviticus 22:3-7). The household could include a servant bought by the priest, but not a hired worker or a guest (Leviticus 22:10-13).

decisions.choice: the offerings that the Israelites wave before me
decisions.reason: Readable explains "wave offerings" by saying what was done with them.

source.text: כֹּ֚ל חֵ֣לֶב יִצְהָ֔ר וְכָל־חֵ֖לֶב תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְדָגָ֑ן רֵאשִׁיתָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־יִתְּנ֥וּ לַֽיהוָ֖ה לְךָ֥ נְתַתִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: All [the] best of [the] fresh oil and all [the] best of [the] new wine and grain, their first [part] which they give to Yahweh, to you I have given them.

en.L: All the best of the fresh oil and all the best of the new wine and the grain, their first [portion] that they give to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, I have given them to you.
en.B: I have given you all the best of the olive oil and all the best of the new wine and the grain, the first part of the harvest that they give to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I am giving you the best of the olive oil, the new wine and the grain. These are the first part of the harvest that the people give to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Todo lo mejor del aceite nuevo y todo lo mejor del vino nuevo y del grano, su primera [porción] que dan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, te lo he dado.
es.B: Te he dado todo lo mejor del aceite de oliva, y todo lo mejor del vino nuevo y del grano, la primera parte de la cosecha que dan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Te doy lo mejor del aceite de oliva, del vino nuevo y del grano. Es la primera parte de la cosecha que la gente le da {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Tout le meilleur de l’huile nouvelle, et tout le meilleur du vin nouveau et du grain, leur première [part] qu’ils donnent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, je te les ai donnés.
fr.B: Je t’ai donné tout le meilleur de l’huile d’olive, et tout le meilleur du vin nouveau et du grain, la première part de la récolte qu’ils donnent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je te donne la meilleure huile d’olive, le meilleur vin nouveau et le meilleur grain. C’est la première part de la récolte que les gens donnent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Bora yote ya mafuta mapya na bora yote ya divai mpya na ya nafaka, sehemu yao ya kwanza wanayompa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimekupa wewe.
sw.B: Nimekupa sehemu bora yote ya mafuta ya zeituni, na sehemu bora yote ya divai mpya na ya nafaka, sehemu ya kwanza ya mavuno wanayompa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ninakupa mafuta bora ya zeituni, divai mpya iliyo bora na nafaka bora. Hiyo ni sehemu ya kwanza ya mavuno ambayo watu humpa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: the best: literally "the fat"
decisions.reason: Fat was thought of as the richest part, so "the fat of" something means its best (Genesis 45:18; Deuteronomy 32:14). The word returns in verses 29-32.

decisions.choice: fresh oil and new wine: oil and wine just pressed
decisions.reason: These words name the oil and wine of the new harvest, before they are stored, and they are often listed with grain (Deuteronomy 7:13; 18:4).

decisions.choice: their first portion: the first part taken from the produce
decisions.reason: This word names the first share set aside from the harvest (Deuteronomy 18:4). Verse 13 uses a different word, the first ripe fruits.

decisions.choice: the first part of the harvest
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "of the harvest" to say what it is the first part of.

source.text: בִּכּוּרֵ֞י כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּאַרְצָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־יָבִ֥יאוּ לַיהוָ֖ה לְךָ֣ יִהְיֶ֑ה כָּל־טָה֥וֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ יֹאכֲלֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] first-ripe fruits of all which [is] in their land, which they bring to Yahweh, to you it will be; every clean [one] in your house will eat it.

en.L: The firstfruits of all that [is] in their land, which they bring to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, shall be yours; everyone who is clean in your house may eat it.
en.B: The first ripe fruits of everything in their land that they bring to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be yours. Everyone in your household who is clean may eat them.
en.R: The first crops that ripen in their land, which they bring to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, will belong to you. Anyone in your family who is clean may eat them.

es.L: Las primicias de todo lo que [hay] en su tierra, que traen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, serán tuyas; todo el que esté puro en tu casa podrá comerlas.
es.B: Las primicias de todo lo que hay en su tierra, que traigan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, serán tuyas. Todo el que esté puro en tu casa podrá comerlas.
es.R: Las primeras cosechas que maduren en su tierra, que traigan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, serán tuyas. Cualquier persona de tu familia que esté pura puede comerlas.

fr.L: Les prémices de tout ce qui [est] dans leur pays, qu’ils apportent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, seront à toi ; quiconque est pur dans ta maison en mangera.
fr.B: Les prémices de tout ce qui pousse dans leur pays, qu’ils apportent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, seront à toi. Tous ceux de ta maison qui sont purs pourront en manger.
fr.R: Les premières récoltes qui mûrissent dans leur pays, et qu’ils apportent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, seront à toi. Toute personne de ta famille qui est pure peut en manger.

sw.L: Malimbuko ya vyote vilivyo katika nchi yao, wanayomletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, yatakuwa yako; kila aliye safi nyumbani mwako atayala.
sw.B: Malimbuko ya kila kitu katika nchi yao wanayomletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yatakuwa yako. Kila aliye safi nyumbani mwako anaweza kuyala.
sw.R: Mavuno ya kwanza yanayoiva katika nchi yao, wanayomletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, yatakuwa yako. Mtu yeyote wa jamaa yako aliye safi anaweza kuyala.

decisions.choice: firstfruits: the first produce to ripen
decisions.reason: The first ripe grain and fruit were brought to the LORD before the rest of the harvest was used (Exodus 23:19; Leviticus 23:10; Deuteronomy 26:2).

decisions.choice: in their land: looking ahead
decisions.reason: Israel is still in the wilderness. The law speaks of the land they will live in, as 15:2 does.

source.text: כָּל־חֵ֥רֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְךָ֥ יִהְיֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Every devoted thing in Israel to you will be.

en.L: Every devoted thing in Israel shall be yours.
en.B: Every devoted thing in Israel will be yours.
en.R: Everything in Israel that is given over completely to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will belong to you.

es.L: Toda cosa consagrada en Israel será tuya.
es.B: Todo lo que se consagre sin reserva en Israel será tuyo.
es.R: Todo lo que en Israel se entregue por completo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} será tuyo.

fr.L: Toute chose vouée en Israël sera à toi.
fr.B: Tout ce qui est consacré sans retour en Israël sera à toi.
fr.R: Tout ce qui, en Israël, est donné entièrement {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} sera à toi.

sw.L: Kila kitu kilichowekwa wakfu katika Israeli kitakuwa chako.
sw.B: Kila kitu kilichowekwa wakfu kabisa katika Israeli kitakuwa chako.
sw.R: Kila kitu katika Israeli kinachotolewa kabisa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kitakuwa chako.

decisions.choice: devoted thing: something given over wholly to the LORD
decisions.reason: A devoted thing was given to the LORD for good and could never be sold or bought back (Leviticus 27:21, 28). In war the word is used of what is destroyed; here it means things given to the sanctuary, which go to the priests.

decisions.choice: given over completely to the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable explains "devoted thing". It does not say "destroy", since here the devoted things are gifts kept for the priests.

decisions.choice: "cosa consagrada" (L), "consagre sin reserva" (B)
decisions.reason: Here the devoted things are gifts kept for the priests, not things destroyed, so Spanish leaves out "destrucción", the wording used for war (Exodus 22:19).

decisions.choice: "chose vouée" (L), "consacré sans retour" (B)
decisions.reason: Here the devoted things are gifts kept for the priests, not things destroyed, so French avoids "interdit" and "destruction", the wording used for war (Exodus 22:19).

source.text: כָּל־פֶּ֣טֶר רֶ֠חֶם לְֽכָל־בָּשָׂ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־יַקְרִ֧יבוּ לַֽיהוָ֛ה בָּאָדָ֥ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֖ה יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֑ךְ אַ֣ךְ׀פָּדֹ֣ה תִפְדֶּ֗ה אֵ֚ת בְּכ֣וֹר הָֽאָדָ֔ם וְאֵ֛ת בְּכֽוֹר־הַבְּהֵמָ֥ה הַטְּמֵאָ֖ה תִּפְדֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Every [thing] opening [the] womb of all flesh which they bring near to Yahweh, among humankind and among animals, to you it will be; only surely you will redeem [the] firstborn of the human, and [the] firstborn of the unclean animal you will redeem.

en.L: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh, which they bring to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, whether of humans or of animals, shall be yours; only you shall surely redeem the firstborn of humans, and the firstborn of unclean animals you shall redeem.
en.B: Every firstborn of every living thing that they bring to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, whether human or animal, will be yours. But you must redeem every firstborn human, and you are to redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.
en.R: Every firstborn that is given to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, whether a child or an animal, will belong to you. But you must let people buy back every firstborn son, and every firstborn of an unclean animal.

es.L: Todo lo que abre la matriz, de toda carne, que presentan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, tanto de los humanos como de los animales, será tuyo; solo que ciertamente rescatarás al primogénito de los humanos, y al primogénito del animal impuro lo rescatarás.
es.B: Todo primogénito de todo ser vivo que presenten {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, sea humano o animal, será tuyo. Pero debes rescatar a todo primogénito humano, y también rescatarás al primogénito de los animales impuros.
es.R: Todo primogénito que se entregue {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, sea un niño o un animal, será tuyo. Pero debes dejar que la gente pague para recuperar a cada primer hijo varón y a cada primera cría de un animal impuro.

fr.L: Tout ce qui ouvre le sein, de toute chair, qu’ils présentent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, parmi les humains comme parmi les bêtes, sera à toi ; seulement, tu rachèteras, oui, tu rachèteras le premier-né des humains, et le premier-né de la bête impure, tu le rachèteras.
fr.B: Tout premier-né de tout être vivant qu’ils présentent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, humain ou animal, sera à toi. Mais tu devras racheter tout premier-né humain, et tu rachèteras aussi le premier-né des animaux impurs.
fr.R: Tout premier-né donné {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, que ce soit un enfant ou un animal, sera à toi. Mais tu dois laisser les gens racheter chaque fils premier-né, et aussi chaque premier-né d’un animal impur.

sw.L: Kila kitu kifunguacho tumbo, cha kila mwenye mwili, wanachomletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, cha wanadamu na cha wanyama, kitakuwa chako; ila hakika utamkomboa mzaliwa wa kwanza wa mwanadamu, na mzaliwa wa kwanza wa mnyama najisi utamkomboa.
sw.B: Kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kila kiumbe hai wanayemletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akiwa binadamu au mnyama, atakuwa wako. Lakini utamkomboa kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa binadamu, na utamkomboa pia mzaliwa wa kwanza wa wanyama najisi.
sw.R: Kila mzaliwa wa kwanza anayetolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, awe mtoto au mnyama, atakuwa wako. Lakini lazima uwaruhusu watu wamkomboe kila mtoto wa kwanza wa kiume, na pia kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa mnyama najisi.

decisions.choice: everything that opens the womb: every firstborn
decisions.reason: The phrase means the first offspring of a mother (Exodus 13:2, 12).

decisions.choice: firstborn belong to the LORD
decisions.reason: When the LORD struck the firstborn of Egypt, he claimed every firstborn in Israel as his own (Exodus 13:2, 15; Numbers 3:13). Here he gives them to the priests.

decisions.choice: you shall surely redeem: the priest must let them be bought back
decisions.reason: Aaron is to take the price and release the firstborn, not keep a human child or an animal that cannot be offered. The doubled verb makes it a firm rule (Exodus 13:13; 34:20).

decisions.choice: unclean animals: animals that could not be offered
decisions.reason: An unclean animal such as a donkey could not be sacrificed, so its firstborn was bought back (Exodus 13:13; Leviticus 27:27).

decisions.choice: every firstborn son; let people buy back
decisions.reason: Readable says "son" because the law of the firstborn concerns males (Exodus 13:12-15), and it says who does what: the family pays and the priest accepts the price.

source.text: וּפְדוּיָו֙ מִבֶּן־חֹ֣דֶשׁ תִּפְדֶּ֔ה בְּעֶ֨רְכְּךָ֔ כֶּ֛סֶף חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And its redemption-price: from [a] son of [a] month you will redeem, by your valuation, silver five shekels by [the] shekel of the holy place; twenty gerah[s] it [is].

en.L: And [as for] its redemption, from a month old you shall redeem [it], by your valuation, [in] silver, five shekels by the sanctuary shekel; it [is] twenty gerahs.
en.B: You are to redeem them from a month old at the set value of {{units:about 2 ounces of silver, by the sanctuary standard|five shekels of silver, by the sanctuary shekel of twenty gerahs}}.
en.R: When the child is a month old, you must let the family buy the child back for {{units:about 2 ounces of silver, weighed by the official weight used at the holy tent|five shekels of silver, weighed by the sanctuary shekel of twenty gerahs}}.

es.L: Y [en cuanto a] su rescate, desde [la edad de] un mes lo rescatarás, según tu valoración, [en] plata, cinco siclos, según el siclo del santuario; él [es] de veinte geras.
es.B: Los rescatarás desde la edad de un mes al valor fijado de {{units:unos 57 gramos de plata, según el peso del santuario|cinco siclos de plata, según el siclo del santuario, que es de veinte geras}}.
es.R: Cuando el niño tenga un mes, debes dejar que la familia lo rescate por {{units:unos 57 gramos de plata, pesados según el peso oficial usado en la tienda santa|cinco siclos de plata, pesados según el siclo del santuario, que es de veinte geras}}.

fr.L: Et [quant à] son rachat, dès l’âge d’un mois tu [le] rachèteras, selon ton estimation, [en] argent, cinq sicles, selon le sicle du sanctuaire ; il [est] de vingt guéras.
fr.B: Tu les rachèteras dès l’âge d’un mois, à la valeur fixée de {{units:environ 57 grammes d’argent, selon le poids du sanctuaire|cinq sicles d’argent, selon le sicle du sanctuaire, qui vaut vingt guéras}}.
fr.R: Quand l’enfant a un mois, tu dois laisser la famille le racheter pour {{units:environ 57 grammes d’argent, pesés selon le poids officiel utilisé à la tente sainte|cinq sicles d’argent, pesés selon le sicle du sanctuaire, qui vaut vingt guéras}}.

sw.L: Na [kuhusu] ukombozi wake, tangu umri wa mwezi mmoja utamkomboa, kwa thamani yako, [kwa] fedha, shekeli tano kwa shekeli ya mahali patakatifu; [ndiyo] gera ishirini.
sw.B: Utawakomboa tangu umri wa mwezi mmoja kwa thamani iliyowekwa ya {{units:karibu gramu 57 za fedha, kwa kipimo cha mahali patakatifu|shekeli tano za fedha, kwa shekeli ya mahali patakatifu yenye gera ishirini}}.
sw.R: Mtoto akifikia umri wa mwezi mmoja, lazima uiruhusu jamaa yake imkomboe kwa {{units:karibu gramu 57 za fedha, zilizopimwa kwa kipimo rasmi cha hema takatifu|shekeli tano za fedha, zilizopimwa kwa shekeli ya mahali patakatifu yenye gera ishirini}}.

decisions.choice: five shekels: the price of a firstborn child
decisions.reason: This is the price paid for the firstborn who had no Levite to take their place (3:47), and the value set for a boy from a month to five years old (Leviticus 27:6). A gerah was a twentieth of a shekel.

decisions.choice: by your valuation: at the fixed value
decisions.reason: As in Leviticus 27:2: a set value, here five shekels, not a price agreed case by case.

decisions.choice: its redemption: the price for a firstborn child
decisions.reason: The verse continues verse 15. "From a month old" shows that it speaks of the human firstborn; the redemption of unclean animals is not priced here (Leviticus 27:27 gives the rule).

decisions.choice: about 2 ounces of silver, by the sanctuary standard
decisions.reason: As in 3:47. Balanced and Readable give the modern weight with the shekel as the alternative; Literal keeps the shekel.

decisions.choice: let the family buy the child back
decisions.reason: Readable says who pays, as in verse 15.

source.text: אַ֣ךְ בְּֽכוֹר־שׁ֡וֹר אֽוֹ־בְכ֨וֹר כֶּ֜שֶׂב אֽוֹ־בְכ֥וֹר עֵ֛ז לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֑ם אֶת־דָּמָ֞ם תִּזְרֹ֤ק עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ וְאֶת־חֶלְבָּ֣ם תַּקְטִ֔יר אִשֶּׁ֛ה לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Only [the] firstborn of [an] ox or [the] firstborn of [a] sheep or [the] firstborn of [a] goat not you will redeem; holy they [are]; their blood you will throw on the altar, and their fat you will make smoke, [a] fire offering for [an] aroma of soothing to Yahweh.

en.L: Only the firstborn of an ox or the firstborn of a sheep or the firstborn of a goat you shall not redeem; they [are] holy. Their blood you shall throw against the altar, and their fat you shall turn into smoke, an offering by fire, for an aroma of soothing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: But you must not redeem the firstborn of a cow, a sheep or a goat; they are holy. Splash their blood against the altar and turn their fat into smoke as a food offering, a soothing aroma to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: But you must not let anyone buy back the firstborn of a cow, a sheep or a goat. They are holy. Splash their blood against the altar, and burn their fat as an offering, a smell that pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Solo que el primogénito de buey, o el primogénito de oveja, o el primogénito de cabra no lo rescatarás; [son] santos. Su sangre la arrojarás sobre el altar, y su grasa la harás humear, ofrenda quemada, como aroma grato para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Pero no rescatarás al primogénito de una vaca, de una oveja o de una cabra; son santos. Salpicarás su sangre contra el altar y harás subir en humo su grasa como ofrenda quemada, aroma grato para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Pero no debes dejar que nadie rescate al primogénito de una vaca, una oveja o una cabra. Son santos. Salpica su sangre contra el altar y quema su grasa como ofrenda, un olor agradable para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Seulement, le premier-né du bœuf, ou le premier-né du mouton, ou le premier-né de la chèvre, tu ne le rachèteras pas ; ils [sont] saints. Tu jetteras leur sang contre l’autel, et tu feras fumer leur graisse, offrande consumée par le feu, en odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Mais tu ne rachèteras pas le premier-né d’une vache, d’un mouton ou d’une chèvre : ils sont saints. Tu projetteras leur sang contre l’autel et tu feras monter leur graisse en fumée, comme offrande consumée par le feu, une odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Mais tu ne dois laisser personne racheter le premier-né d’une vache, d’un mouton ou d’une chèvre. Ils sont saints. Projette leur sang contre l’autel, et brûle leur graisse comme offrande, une odeur qui plaît {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Ila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa ng'ombe, au mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kondoo, au mzaliwa wa kwanza wa mbuzi, usimkomboe; [wao ni] watakatifu. Damu yao utairusha juu ya madhabahu, na shahamu yao utaifukiza, sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto, kuwa harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Lakini usimkomboe mzaliwa wa kwanza wa ng'ombe, wa kondoo au wa mbuzi; hao ni watakatifu. Rusha damu yao juu ya madhabahu, na ufukize shahamu yao kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Lakini usimruhusu mtu yeyote amkomboe mzaliwa wa kwanza wa ng'ombe, wa kondoo au wa mbuzi. Hao ni watakatifu. Rusha damu yao kwenye madhabahu, na uchome shahamu yao kuwa sadaka, harufu inayompendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: not redeemed: clean animals are offered, not bought back
decisions.reason: The firstborn of cattle, sheep and goats could be sacrificed, so they already belonged to the LORD and could not be bought back or given for a vow (Leviticus 27:26).

decisions.choice: blood on the altar, fat burned: as with a peace offering
decisions.reason: The blood and fat went to the LORD and the meat to the priests (verse 18), as in the peace offering (Leviticus 3:2-5; 7:31-34).

decisions.choice: an offering by fire, an aroma of soothing
decisions.reason: As in Leviticus 1:9: an offering the LORD accepts with pleasure.

decisions.choice: food offering
decisions.reason: As in Leviticus 1:9: Balanced says "food offering" and Literal "offering by fire".

source.text: וּבְשָׂרָ֖ם יִהְיֶה־לָּ֑ךְ כַּחֲזֵ֧ה הַתְּנוּפָ֛ה וּכְשׁ֥וֹק הַיָּמִ֖ין לְךָ֥ יִהְיֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And their meat will be to you; like [the] breast of the wave offering and like the right thigh, to you it will be.

en.L: And their meat shall be yours; like the breast of the wave offering and like the right thigh, it shall be yours.
en.B: Their meat will be yours, just as the breast of the wave offering and the right thigh are yours.
en.R: Their meat will belong to you, just like the breast that is waved before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and the right thigh.

es.L: Y su carne será tuya; como el pecho de la ofrenda mecida y como el muslo derecho, será tuya.
es.B: Su carne será tuya, así como son tuyos el pecho de la ofrenda mecida y el muslo derecho.
es.R: Su carne será tuya, igual que el pecho que se mece delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y el muslo derecho.

fr.L: Et leur viande sera à toi ; comme la poitrine de l’offrande balancée et comme la cuisse droite, elle sera à toi.
fr.B: Leur viande sera à toi, tout comme la poitrine de l’offrande balancée et la cuisse droite sont à toi.
fr.R: Leur viande sera à toi, comme la poitrine que l’on balance devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et la cuisse droite.

sw.L: Na nyama yao itakuwa yako; kama kidari cha sadaka ya kutikiswa na kama paja la kulia, itakuwa yako.
sw.B: Nyama yao itakuwa yako, kama vile kidari cha sadaka ya kutikiswa na paja la kulia vilivyo vyako.
sw.R: Nyama yao itakuwa yako, kama kidari kinachotikiswa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na paja la kulia.

decisions.choice: like the breast and the right thigh: portions the priest's family may eat
decisions.reason: From every peace offering the breast and the right thigh went to the priest (Leviticus 7:31-34). His sons and daughters could eat them in any clean place (Leviticus 10:14). The meat of the firstborn animals is given on the same terms.

decisions.choice: the breast that is waved before me
decisions.reason: Readable explains "wave offering" as in verse 11.

source.text: כֹּ֣ל׀תְּרוּמֹ֣ת הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֥ימוּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לַֽיהוָה֒ נָתַ֣תִּֽי לְךָ֗ וּלְבָנֶ֧יךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶ֛יךָ אִתְּךָ֖ לְחָק־עוֹלָ֑ם בְּרִית֩ מֶ֨לַח עוֹלָ֥ם הִוא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְךָ֖ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אִתָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: All [the] contributions of the holy things which present [the] sons of Israel to Yahweh I have given to you and to your sons and to your daughters with you for [a] due forever; [a] covenant of salt forever it [is] before Yahweh for you and for your offspring with you.

en.L: All the contributions of the holy things that the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel present to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I have given to you and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a due forever; it [is] a covenant of salt forever before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for you and for your offspring with you."
en.B: All the holy contributions that the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} set aside for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I have given to you and to your sons and daughters with you as a permanent share. It is a covenant of salt forever before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for you and your descendants with you."
en.R: I am giving you and your sons and daughters all the holy gifts that the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} set apart for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They will be your share for all time. It is a covenant of salt before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, a covenant that will never end, for you and your descendants."

es.L: Todas las ofrendas alzadas de las cosas santas que los hijos de Israel presentan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} te las he dado a ti y a tus hijos y a tus hijas contigo, como derecho perpetuo; pacto de sal perpetuo [es] delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para ti y para tu descendencia contigo».
es.B: Todas las contribuciones santas que los israelitas apartan para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te las he dado a ti y a tus hijos y a tus hijas contigo como una parte permanente. Es un pacto de sal para siempre delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para ti y para tu descendencia contigo».
es.R: Te doy a ti y a tus hijos y a tus hijas todas las ofrendas santas que los israelitas apartan para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Serán su parte para siempre. Es un pacto de sal delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, un pacto que nunca terminará, para ti y para tus descendientes».

fr.L: Toutes les offrandes élevées des choses saintes que les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël présentent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, je te les ai données, à toi, à tes fils et à tes filles avec toi, comme dû perpétuel ; c’[est] une alliance de sel perpétuelle devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour toi et pour ta descendance avec toi. »
fr.B: Toutes les contributions saintes que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} mettent à part pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je te les ai données, à toi, à tes fils et à tes filles avec toi, comme une part permanente. C’est une alliance de sel pour toujours devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour toi et ta descendance avec toi. »
fr.R: Je te donne, à toi, à tes fils et à tes filles, tous les dons saints que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} mettent à part pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ce sera votre part pour toujours. C’est une alliance de sel devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, une alliance qui ne finira jamais, pour toi et tes descendants. »

sw.L: Sadaka zote za kuinuliwa za vitu vitakatifu ambazo wana wa Israeli wanamtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nimekupa wewe na wanao na binti zako pamoja nawe, kuwa fungu la kudumu milele; [ni] agano la chumvi la milele mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwako na kwa uzao wako pamoja nawe."
sw.B: Michango yote mitakatifu ambayo Waisraeli wanamtengea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nimekupa wewe na wanao na binti zako pamoja nawe kuwa fungu la kudumu. Ni agano la chumvi la milele mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwako na kwa wazao wako pamoja nawe."
sw.R: Ninakupa wewe na wanao na binti zako matoleo yote matakatifu ambayo Waisraeli humtengea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Yatakuwa fungu lenu milele. Ni agano la chumvi mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, agano lisilokwisha kamwe, kwako na kwa wazao wako."

decisions.choice: a covenant of salt: a covenant meant to last
decisions.reason: Salt keeps food from spoiling, and eating salt together sealed a bond between people. Salt was added to every offering as "the salt of the covenant of your God" (Leviticus 2:13). The LORD's covenant with David is also called a covenant of salt (2 Chronicles 13:5).

decisions.choice: all the contributions: a summary of verses 8-18
decisions.reason: The verse sums up the gifts listed since verse 8 and closes the list with a lasting promise.

decisions.choice: it: the grant of these gifts to the priests
decisions.reason: "It" is the arrangement just described, the LORD's gift of the holy portions to Aaron's family. It is a covenant made before the LORD and binding for later generations.

decisions.choice: a covenant that will never end
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "covenant of salt" and adds what it implies, since the meaning of salt here is not obvious to a modern reader.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֗ן בְּאַרְצָם֙ לֹ֣א תִנְחָ֔ל וְחֵ֕לֶק לֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ בְּתוֹכָ֑ם אֲנִ֤י חֶלְקְךָ֙ וְנַחֲלָ֣תְךָ֔ בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Aaron, in their land not you will inherit, and [a] portion not will be to you among them; I [am] your portion and your inheritance in [the] midst of [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Aaron, "In their land you shall not inherit, and no portion shall be yours among them; I [am] your portion and your inheritance among the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Aaron, "You will have no inheritance in their land, and you will have no portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Aaron, "You will not own any land among them. You will not get a share of it as the other tribes do. I am your share. I am what you will receive among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

es.L: Y dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Aarón: «En la tierra de ellos no tendrás herencia, y porción no tendrás entre ellos; yo [soy] tu porción y tu herencia en medio de los hijos de Israel.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Aarón: «No tendrás herencia en la tierra de ellos, ni tendrás porción entre ellos. Yo soy tu porción y tu herencia en medio de los israelitas.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Aarón: «Tú no tendrás tierras entre ellos. No recibirás una parte como las demás tribus. Yo soy tu parte. Yo soy lo que recibirás entre los israelitas.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Aaron : « Dans leur pays tu n’hériteras pas, et aucune part ne sera à toi au milieu d’eux ; je [suis] ta part et ton héritage au milieu des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Aaron : « Tu n’auras pas d’héritage dans leur pays, et tu n’auras pas de part au milieu d’eux. C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui suis ta part et ton héritage au milieu des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Aaron : « Tu ne posséderas pas de terre parmi eux. Tu n’en recevras pas une part comme les autres tribus. C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui suis ta part. C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} que tu recevras au milieu des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Haruni, "Katika nchi yao hutarithi, wala hutakuwa na fungu kati yao; {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ndimi] fungu lako na urithi wako kati ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Haruni, "Hutakuwa na urithi katika nchi yao, wala hutakuwa na fungu kati yao. Mimi ndimi fungu lako na urithi wako kati ya Waisraeli.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Haruni, "Hutamiliki ardhi yoyote kati yao. Hutapata sehemu ya nchi kama makabila mengine. Mimi ndimi fungu lako. Mimi ndiye utakayempata kati ya Waisraeli.

decisions.choice: inherit, portion: a share of the land passed down in the family
decisions.reason: When the land was divided, each tribe and clan received land as an inheritance, to be kept in the family (26:52-56). The priests were to receive none (Joshua 13:14, 33).

decisions.choice: I am your portion and your inheritance
decisions.reason: Instead of land, the priests have the LORD himself. In practice he provides for them through the gifts given to him (Deuteronomy 10:9; 18:1-2). The same words are later used of anyone who trusts in the LORD (Psalm 16:5; 73:26).

decisions.choice: you: Aaron, standing for his whole line
decisions.reason: The verb is singular, but it covers Aaron's descendants, as the gifts in verses 8-19 do.

decisions.choice: own any land; as the other tribes do
decisions.reason: Readable says what an inheritance is and how the priests differ from the other tribes.

source.text: וְלִבְנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י הִנֵּ֥ה נָתַ֛תִּי כָּל־מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְנַחֲלָ֑ה חֵ֤לֶף עֲבֹֽדָתָם֙ אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֣ם עֹֽבְדִ֔ים אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And to [the] sons of Levi, look, I have given every tithe in Israel for [an] inheritance, in return for their service which they [are] serving, [the] service of [the] tent of meeting.

en.L: And to the sons of Levi, look, I have given every tithe in Israel as an inheritance, in return for their service that they serve, the service of the tent of meeting.
en.B: To the Levites I have given every tithe in Israel as their inheritance, in return for the work they do, the work of the tent of meeting.
en.R: I am giving the Levites a tenth of everything that is produced in Israel. That will be their share, in return for the work they do at the meeting tent.

es.L: Y a los hijos de Leví, he aquí, les he dado todo diezmo en Israel como herencia, a cambio de su servicio que ellos sirven, el servicio de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.B: A los levitas les he dado como herencia todos los diezmos de Israel, a cambio del trabajo que hacen, el trabajo de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.R: Doy a los levitas la décima parte de todo lo que se produce en Israel. Esa será su parte, a cambio del trabajo que hacen en la Tienda del Encuentro.

fr.L: Et aux fils de Lévi, voici, j’ai donné toute dîme en Israël comme héritage, en échange de leur service qu’ils accomplissent, le service de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.B: Aux Lévites, j’ai donné toutes les dîmes d’Israël comme héritage, en échange du travail qu’ils font, le travail de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.R: Je donne aux Lévites un dixième de tout ce qui est produit en Israël. Ce sera leur part, en échange du travail qu’ils font à la tente de la Rencontre.

sw.L: Na kwa wana wa Lawi, tazama, nimewapa kila fungu la kumi katika Israeli kuwa urithi, badala ya huduma yao wanayoitumikia, huduma ya Hema la Kukutania.
sw.B: Kwa Walawi nimewapa kila fungu la kumi katika Israeli kuwa urithi wao, badala ya kazi wanayoifanya, kazi ya Hema la Kukutania.
sw.R: Ninawapa Walawi sehemu ya kumi ya kila kitu kinachozalishwa katika Israeli. Hiyo itakuwa fungu lao, badala ya kazi wanayoifanya katika Hema la Kukutania.

decisions.choice: tithe: a tenth of the produce
decisions.reason: A tenth of the grain, the fruit of the trees and the herds and flocks belonged to the LORD (Leviticus 27:30-32). Here he gives it to the Levites.

decisions.choice: as an inheritance: in place of land
